The '''''Quartermaster''-class supply carrier''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and civilian users after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It had a reinforced duranium hull which allowed it to withstand punishing damage without breaching and spilling its cargo into space.

==History==
The ''Quartermaster''-class was designed specifically to carry a variety of goods and raw materials to worlds in desperate need of reconstruction or relief following the devastation of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Since military ships were ill-equipped to carry supplies and materials, the need arose for a specific supply carrier, and the ''Quartermaster''-class was mostly cargo space outfitted to carry a variety of cargoes, including liquids and gases, which made it a popular supply vessel.<ref name="kotorcg" />

By the time of [[Mandalorian Wars]] some ships have been retired and some served as supply vessels for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. It generally required escort of some type, often by traveling in a convoy including one or more [[Praetorian-class frigate|''Praetorian''-class frigates]].<ref name="kotorcg" />

At least one ship of this class, the ''[[Little Bivoli]]'', was operated by a [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] group which provided provisions to the [[Battle Group Serroco|''Courageous'' battle group]]. It was stolen from its original operators by [[Slyssk]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]]<ref name="kotor13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref> but continued to serve in its intended role<ref name="kotor14">[[Knights of the Old Republic 14|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 14]]</ref> until it was destroyed in the [[Battle of Serroco]].<ref name="kotor15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Quartermaster''-class was originally created for the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Days of Fear|''Days of Fear'']] arc of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] comic series. Its class name was not established until the publication of the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.
